finding.before: The host preflight checked AC power, sleep, hibernate, disk and clock but did not inspect the hidden lid-close action or strong Windows reboot-pending markers.
finding.risk: A closed lid configured to sleep on AC, or a CBS/Windows Update hard reboot requirement, could interrupt the approved 24-hour writer.
finding.resolution: The read-only checker now fails closed on AC lid interruption, unavailable reboot status, CBS reboot pending and Windows Update reboot required. DC-only lid/sleep and PendingFileRenameOperations remain explicit warnings.

warning_interpretation.battery_sleep_and_lid: Non-blocking while AC remains connected. The exact preflight blocks launch if AC is offline.
warning_interpretation.pending_file_rename_operations: A weak and often stale marker; it is not treated as a hard reboot requirement unless CBS or Windows Update strong markers are present.
warning_interpretation.disk_idle: Non-blocking because the approved campaign continuously writes to the output drive.
warning_interpretation.time_sync_age: Non-blocking because the observed absolute phase offset is far below the 0.5-second blocker threshold.

next_action: Repeat the exact read-only host preflight immediately before actual dense launch and proceed only with status READY and no blockers.
